Studied: Hero Law.description:
📜 You studied Quirk law and hero regulation: pre-law classes, a hero-prep cram school or a parent's legal textbooks.

🌱 Registration, the ban on public Quirk use, self-defense, Commission licensing and arrest powers. You can tell what a hero may do at a scene.
⚠️ Case law, Commission policy and the gray areas of a real incident still need a lawyer.
⚖️ Knowing the law is neither a hero license nor a license to practice law, and the rules bind you as much as anyone.
🏫 It shows in precise questions about who authorized what.

📈 Grants: Hero Law +15
Studied: Hero Law.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied the law around Quirks and heroes: Quirk registration, the ban on public Quirk use, self-defense, licensing by the Hero Public Safety Commission, arrest powers, use of force, jurisdiction and liability. They can tell what a hero may do at a scene and what a civilian may not. Prior study, not mastery: case law, Commission policy and the gray areas of a real incident still need a lawyer. Not a license: knowing the law is neither a hero license nor a license to practice law, and the rules bind them no less than anyone else. It shows in precise questions about who authorized what.
